_about: One place for facts several components repeat. Edit here, then run: python3 tools/lumebook.py ripple. The dashboard (sites/dashboard/refresh.py) reads this file; tools/lumebook.py check flags copies elsewhere that disagree.

brand._instagram_live_source: Israeli product Reels research, 15 Oct 2026: @lumebook.il is the live handle and @lumebookai no longer loads for logged-out visitors. refresh.py still counts followers of 'instagram'.

offer._source: Yossi via Yarin, 2026-10-04; corrected 2026-10-07 (no discount code, personal link); 2026-10-08 the number is 25%; 2026-10-11 Yarin confirmed the split mechanics below
offer.allocation_rule: One 25% allocation per sale through the creator's personal link. The creator decides how much of it is their earnings and how much is an audience discount. The discount is applied automatically through the link. It is never 25% earnings plus an extra discount.
offer.commission_wording_he: 25% מכל מכירה דרך הקישור האישי, לחלוקה בין הרווח של היוצר להנחה לקהל (למשל 15% ליוצר ו-10% הנחה)

collaboration_tracks.gift: General: a personalised book in exchange for one agreed video, plus the personal-link arrangement. Commission only, no fee
collaboration_tracks.pro: Professionals: the same offer, written for therapists, parent guides, teachers and other professionals
collaboration_tracks.par: Parents: the same offer, written parent to parent

open_questions: How the sale value behind the 25% is calculated (price only, or shipping too)
How the personal link and its automatic discount are tracked and attributed at checkout
Whether the creator can change their split later
offer._answered_by: The store's binding terms answer all four open questions; see ambassador_program and docs/ambassadors/fact-table.md (15 Nov 2026).

ambassador_program._source: lumebook.com read on 15 Nov 2026: terms at /IL/he/ambassadors/terms (version ambassadors-2026-11-01b, in force from 1 Oct 2026, updated 1 Nov 2026), GET /api/ambassadors/program and the page's own code. The store is the source of truth; the redesigned page (sites/lumebook-ambassadors-v2) reads the live settings at runtime and uses these numbers only as its static fallback. Section numbers and the open questions: docs/ambassadors/fact-table.md
ambassador_program._share_note: Yarin, 15 Nov 2026: "זה 25% לא 30 שקלים". Every page presents the reward as 25% of the printed book's price, split between the buyer's discount and the ambassador's reward, never as ₪30. The live store page does the same: it computes floor(budgetMinor / regular price) = 25% and shows each ₪5 step as its part of that (₪15 = 12.5%). The store's terms 4.1 and GET /api/ambassadors/program still state a ₪30 budget per book (25.2% of ₪119); budget_ils and step_ils below are those settings, used only to compute.
open_questions: Deadline for publishing the Reel (not stated anywhere)
When and how the brief reaches a new ambassador
Whether anyone checks the profile or the book before it is printed
